create_configurable_class: create a Configurable subclass with typed fields and call run_auto_creation in __post_init__
register_replaceable_subclass: register a ReplaceableBase subclass with the registry decorator so it can be selected by name at runtime
get_default_args: get an OmegaConf DictConfig with default arguments for initializing a Configurable or ReplaceableBase class
remove_unused_components: remove unused pluggable component args from a DictConfig to simplify the configuration structure
enable_get_default_args_on_function: enable get_default_args on a plain function or class so it returns a DictConfig of its default parameters
